plan.name: High-Resolution DD32 Convergence Ladder

rungs.name: R0_N360_K8_LINEAR
rungs.description: Baseline at historical FULL spatial/spectral resolution; linear convergence only.

rungs.name: R2_N720_K8_SPATIAL
rungs.description: High spatial refinement with fixed k_max=8; closes spatial tail.

rungs.name: R4_N720_K16_SPECTRAL
rungs.description: High spectral refinement at fixed N=720; closes spectral tail.

rungs.name: R5_N720_K16_ROBUST_FULL
rungs.description: Final full-dynamics rung plus large-epsilon robustness probes.

interpretation: R0-R2 isolate spatial convergence at fixed k_max=8.
R2-R4 isolate spectral convergence at fixed N=720.
R5 keeps N=720,k_max=16 and adds eps=0.012,0.016 only as robustness probes; P1 uses only eps<=0.008.
A resolution conclusion is not accepted from an extrapolation fit unless the measured high-resolution tail also contracts and is quasi-monotone.
Large dominant-eigenvector weight on k_max marks spectral truncation as unresolved.
DD32 is not IEEE FP64; near-threshold, unresolved, RPO and Floquet cases remain queued for CPU/OpenMP FP64 confirmation.
